Contact

Reader, planning, and partnership inquiries.

Use this page to contact Chinese Wedding Traditions about corrections, broken links, planning-resource suggestions, product context, or reader questions about Chinese wedding customs.

Email:
guan@shanyuegroup.com

Helpful details to send

For a correction, include the URL, the sentence that needs review, and the regional or family context behind the change. For a planning question, describe the ceremony type, country, family languages, and which custom needs explanation. We can improve general educational pages, but we cannot resolve family disputes or replace a professional planner.

For product or partnership notes, include the product category, ceremony use case, images or label information, and any required disclosure. The site may discuss gifts, decor, red envelopes, checklists, and ceremony tools, but it avoids exaggerated promises or pressure-based sales language.

Response boundaries

We cannot provide legal, immigration, financial, safety, mental health, or religious advice. For contracts, venue requirements, legal marriage rules, immigration matters, or urgent family safety concerns, contact a qualified professional in the relevant location.

The form opens your email app. You can also email us directly using the address above.
